sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "aliases" TEXT NOT NULL, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL, "primary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL, "secondary_muscles" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL, "mechanic" TEXT NULL, "force" TEXT NULL, "instructions" TEXT NULL, "measure_weight" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_weight" IN (0, 1)), "measure_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_reps" IN (0, 1)), "measure_duration" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_duration" IN (0, 1)), "measure_distance" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_distance" IN (0, 1)), "load_mode" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_semantics" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_unilateral" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_unilateral" IN (0, 1)), "image_ref" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_ref" TEXT NULL, "license" TEXT NULL, "license_author" TEXT NULL, "seed_version" INTEGER NULL, "user_modified" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("user_modified" IN (0, 1)), "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (measure_weight OR measure_reps OR measure_duration OR measure_distance));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "templates" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "description" TEXT NULL, "archived_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_min" INTEGER NULL, "target_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_weight_g" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "default_set_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "template_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "template_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES template_exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_type" TEXT NULL, "target_min" INTEGER NULL, "target_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_weight_g" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sessions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ended_at" INTEGER NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES templates (id), "template_name_snapshot" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "wellbeing" INTEGER NULL CHECK("wellbeing" BETWEEN 1 AND 5), "rest_ends_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_sessions (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "template_exercise_id" TEXT NULL, "exercise_name_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "measure_weight_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_weight_snapshot" IN (0, 1)), "measure_reps_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_reps_snapshot" IN (0, 1)), "measure_duration_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_duration_snapshot" IN (0, 1)), "measure_distance_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("measure_distance_snapshot" IN (0, 1)), "load_mode_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_semantics_snapshot" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_unilateral_snapshot" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("is_unilateral_snapshot" IN (0, 1)), "note" TEXT NULL, "group_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "session_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "session_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES session_exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "set_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_kind" TEXT NULL, "target_min" INTEGER NULL, "target_max" INTEGER NULL, "target_weight_g" INTEGER NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NULL, "weight_g" INTEGER NULL, "reps" INTEGER NULL CHECK("reps" >= 0), "duration_s" INTEGER NULL CHECK("duration_s" >= 0), "distance_m" INTEGER NULL CHECK("distance_m" >= 0), "effort_scale" TEXT NULL, "effort_tenths" INTEGER NULL, "side" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weekly_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "starts_on" TEXT NOT NULL, "ends_on" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weekly_plan_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "plan_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES weekly_plans (id), "weekday" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("weekday" BETWEEN 1 AND 7), "template_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES templates (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "planned_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "template_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES templates (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), CHECK (kind <> 'workout' OR template_id IS NOT NULL));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_substitutes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "deleted_at" INTEGER NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "substitute_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES exercises (id), "position" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE INDEX idx_exercises_source ON exercises (source)
CREATE INDEX idx_template_exercises_template ON template_exercises (template_id, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_template_exercises_exercise ON template_exercises (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_template_sets_template_exercise ON template_sets (template_exercise_id, position)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ux_workout_sessions_one_active ON workout_sessions (status) WHERE status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_sessions_local_date ON workout_sessions (local_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_sessions_started_at ON workout_sessions (started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_workout_sessions_template ON workout_sessions (template_id, started_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_session ON session_exercises (session_id, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_exercises_exercise ON session_exercises (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_session_sets_session_exercise ON session_sets (session_exercise_id, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_weekly_plan_days_plan ON weekly_plan_days (plan_id, weekday, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_planned_days_date ON planned_days (date, position)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_substitutes_exercise ON exercise_substitutes (exercise_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_exercise_substitutes_substitute ON exercise_substitutes (substitute_id)
